title: run_with_timeout doesn't actually cancel B2 SDK operations
details: ThreadPoolExecutor.cancel() only cancels the future if it hasn't started. Once the B2 SDK call is running, it cannot be interrupted. Long-running uploads/downloads will continue in background threads, potentially leaking threads and consuming resources.

title: SHA-1 cache (_sha1_cache) grows unbounded, potential memory leak
details: Global _sha1_cache dict is never cleared. For operations with thousands of files, it grows indefinitely. Should have a max size or LRU eviction, or be cleared after operation completes.

title: rel_path computation in OperationState.create uses fragile string replace
details: Uses str(abs_path).replace(str(Path(source_dir).resolve()), '').lstrip('/') which is fragile. Should use Path.relative_to() for correct relative path computation.

title: verify_only/check modes don't handle missing local files gracefully
details: In --verify-only and --check modes, compute_sha1 is called on src_file.abs_path without checking if file exists. If user deleted local files, this will raise OSError and crash.

title: allocate_files doesn't share account_remaining across buckets of same account
details: bucket_info stores (bucket, bucket_remaining, account_remaining) per bucket. account_remaining is copied by value. When one bucket uses capacity, only that bucket's account_remaining is updated. Other buckets in same account still think full account capacity is available. This can cause OVER-ALLOCATION beyond account limit.

title: Missing confirmation prompt before starting upload (was removed)
details: The --yes flag exists but there's no interactive confirmation prompt when --yes is not provided. The code just proceeds to upload without asking. This is a regression from earlier version that had input() prompt.

title: No Unicode normalization for filenames
details: Filenames with different Unicode normalizations (NFC vs NFD) are treated as different by B2 but may appear identical to users. Could cause confusion or duplicates.

title: No validation of object_name for B2 forbidden characters
details: B2 object names cannot contain certain control characters. get_unique_object_name doesn't validate this. Could cause upload failures with cryptic errors.

title: collect_source_files doesn't handle permission errors on directories
details: os.walk will raise PermissionError if it encounters a directory it can't read. Not caught - will crash the entire operation.
